01What this object holds

Type
object
Full path
/electron-persisted-atom-state/cloud-aeon-sidebar-cache-v1/threads/<item>
Meaning

One cached thread summary.

Behavior

Account/user/host ownership gates cached cloud data. The sidebar hydrates summaries and profiles from it, while archive/delete listeners remove stale entries; this cache is not the authoritative cloud agent or message store.

Evidence
inferred [snapshot]; [Bd7c102df]
Limits

Field role is reconstructed from the observed shape and matching desktop consumer; private values are withheld.

02Objects and folders

Object folderTypeWhat it holds

32Sources and limits

Observed structure comes from one read-only local snapshot on 3 October 2026. Behavioral explanations cite the installed ChatGPT desktop bundle, version26.928.31416 (12553), or are explicitly marked as inference. Official documentation is used only for supported configuration boundaries. The folder representation and operating-system implications are reconstructions or proposals.

All primitive values and identifying dynamic keys were omitted. Repeated objects and object-array items are unions of every observed member, including empty structures; embedded tool-schema property maps use placeholders. The original file was not edited. Features absent from the snapshot, server behavior, offline editing, and restoration were not tested. The published content is versioned research, not a supported global-state API.
